research_basis: W3C Trace Context traceparent fields: version, trace-id, parent-id/span-id, trace-flags.
OpenTelemetry Log Data Model fields: Timestamp, ObservedTimestamp, SeverityText, SeverityNumber, TraceId, SpanId, TraceFlags, Resource, Attributes, EventName.
OpenTelemetry Resource semantic conventions: service.name is required when known, service.version identifies deployed code.

constraints.trace_id: 32 lowercase hex characters and not all zeroes
constraints.span_id: 16 lowercase hex characters and not all zeroes
constraints.attributes: must contain sanitized metadata only; raw prompt text, customer IDs, absolute image paths, secrets, and tokens are not allowed
